preconditions.description: The number of points n is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= xi <= 10**9 and -10**9 <= yi <= 10**9 for xi, yi in points)
preconditions.description: Each point's coordinates are within the range [-10^9, 10^9].
The number of points matches the given n.

postconditions.description: The number of points m in the superset is between n and 200,000.

postconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= xi <= 10**9 and -10**9 <= yi <= 10**9 for xi, yi in superset_points)
postconditions.description: Each point in the superset has coordinates within the range [-10^9, 10^9].
The original set of points is a subset of the superset.

postconditions.expression: all(any((x1 == x2 or y1 == y2 or any((min(x1, x2) < x < max(x1, x2) and min(y1, y2) < y < max(y1, y2)) for x, y in superset_points if (x, y) != (x1, y1) and (x, y) != (x2, y2))) for (x1, y1), (x2, y2) in combinations(superset_points, 2))
postconditions.description: For any two points in the superset, at least one of the three conditions is true.
